verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud pricing is per dedicated cluster "with no limits on records or operations" (typesense-docs-20), so there are no per-request cliffs. The full engine can also be self-hosted free forever under GPL-3.0 (typesense-docs-56, typesense-docs-39). Community reports that data is held in memory imply cost scales with RAM as records grow (typesense-comm-4, typesense-comm-6), though one user measured a modest footprint (typesense-comm-5). missing for 10: published cluster price tiers or a worked cost-scaling example, independent confirmation of bill predictability at scale, and clarity on how RAM-driven cluster upgrades affect cost as records grow.
